nom: The Ordinary 100% Plant-Derived Squalane for Skin and Hair Hydration

avis.titre: Some of my lines have disappeared!
avis.texte: This stuff is Amazing. My brow furrows are all the way gone! No cosmetic injections necessary.

I got this oil/serum as the last step on my belly rutine, I love that is not super oily, squalene is really important for skin hydration, im not into the oil in mu body so this is the perfect product. Does not leave stains on my clothes or anything.

avis.titre: FABULOUS for skin, not for hair
avis.texte: I've been using this squalene at night as a serum between a glycolic acid toner and hyaluronic acid moisturizer. While it feels a little oily at first, it absorbs well after massaging it in and leaves my skin with a glow that lasts all day. 10/10 step in my skin care because i appreciate a simple routine with simple formulas. However, it left my 2b hair oily and stringy after using it after every wash (2-3/week) for about two months.

This is my first purchase of this product and I LOVE it. My skin is very dry, and this is a great moisturizer. I really like this brand, great results ar a great price. I will purchase this product again.

I got this serum a while back and used it on my face. I can't remember what I thought of it for that purpose but I started using it on damp and dry hair and it's truly a game changer. I have a lot of fine frizzy hair that breaks easily and lacks movement. Adding a couple drops to damp hair has helped so much. I also add a few drops and put it on my ends so my hair isn't so fluffy. I highly recommend.

Im in my 40's minimal signs of aging so far. I use this oil at th end of my routine to seal everything in. When i first started using it years ago i would get so many compliments i started giving it out at gift….. saw reviews saying its too "oily"…. Well its literally an oil so dont give it a bad review because you dont like oil….. just may idk dont buy it?

avis.titre: i would maybe buy this again
avis.texte: it was okay made my face very oily but DO NOT use it everyday!

i add three drops to enough facial moisturizer to cover my face and neck. it's a perfect boost for dry, wind-chapped skin in the winter. it's medium-weight and feels a little dewy. no residue or stickiness, no irritation or clogged pores. just comfort and relief from tightness and dullness. i don't love it in my hair. i have mid-back length 2A hair that's gotten very coarse, as it's about 60-70% gray. the oil just kind of sits on the hair rather than absorbing in.
Affordable and works wonderful on my dehydrated skin. This is probably my 8th bottle. Use it after moisturizer and you will get supple, glowing skin.
I was hoping to get the benefits of squalene with a simple serum, unfortunately even using just a few drops, it was really, really oily. Returned because not something I'd use more than once.

This gives my hair beautiful shine without being too oily. A lot of hair oils are a bit much for my hair, but this is soft and comfortable for me as a very last step in my hair routine. I kind of smoothed it over and scrunched it in after my hair was completely dry (to break the cast and give some shine). My hair is course, curly, low porosity, and perpetually needs moisture, but it feels soft with this. I really like it

I pair this and Ordinary niamacide every morning before applying my liquid foundation. I am obsessed. Never in my 34 years of life have I been told I have 'glowing, radiant skin' until I used this!! I struggle w/ acne and it doesn't break me out.

Recently started using and WOW! , My face and body skin have 100% improved. I have extremely dry, sensitive, ezcema and allergy prone skin and this will for ever be my go to. I mix 3-4 drops with my face moisturizer and with my body lotion. I hope they never change the formula.

avis.titre: Acne Prone Combo Skin? This is for you
avis.texte: I have suffered with acne all my life and no matter how "lightweight" the moisturizer it would inevitably clog my pores and or cause skin irritation. I was initially skeptical at the idea of a straight up oil being non-comedogenic but between the salicylic acid cleanser and the a-dap gel my skin was screaming for moisture, so I took a leap and I am SO GLAD that I did. This is now a mandatory part of my skin care routine BONUS it removes eye makeup like a dream.

avis.titre: If you're dry this is your solution
avis.texte: Cannot recommend this enough if you are a dry girlie like me! I have eczema and my face was so scaly and patchy everything was irritating me, I was ready to give up on serums completely. But I saw someone online recommend squalane and decided to give this one a shot and omg so glad I did! In a matter of 2-3 days I saw an improvement and here I am like 12 bottles later, still in love with this product This is my ride or die product. May they never discontinue this!

avis.titre: This is my number one favorite item perfect for my skin
avis.texte: Definitely recommend this product doesn't leave you oily refreshes your smooth skin all day

I just started using this about a week ago and I'm thoroughly impressed. I can actually apply this to every part of my face without any irritation or breakouts. I've tried a few different facial products over the past couple of years. I have oily/combination skin and I usually cannot put any product on my forehead, cheeks, nor chin. Even if they claim the product is oil free, non-comedogenic, and for sensitive skin. I will definitely buy this again.

Love it so far. This is the only product so far that has left my skin feeling moisturized ALL day. Typically I am left feeling dry after an hour of applying my skincare. This has been a complete game changer.

Ive been using this product for a couple of months now and it has easily became a staple in my weekly skin routine. I add only 2-3 drops to my moisturizer and it gives the perfect boost in hydration. I found i have the best absorption when i pair with a quickly absorbing moisturizer. While useful in skincare, do not skip on the hair care! I cannot speak enough on how great this serum is for my hair. In fact, I primarily use this serum for my hair! I have thin, straight hair which is susceptible to breakage and dries out easily. I find when i add 4-5 drops into the palm of my hand, warm it up, then apply to my the ends of my hair while damp, i have the shiniest and smoothest hair. Never mind your hair glosses, oils, and rinses - this stuff is far cheaper and does a similar if not better job at achieving those healthy hair gosls. Definitely recommend giving it a try!
I love The Ordinary product line. So I bought the squalane to add a drop to my under eye concealer to keep it from creasing. It works like a charm!

avis.titre: For the guys with beards, too!
avis.texte: I decided to give this a try as I was breaking out under my beard during the cold months. No more itchy dry, flakey skin under the beard and my breakouts have cleared up. Skin looks and feels great! Highly, highly recommend!

avis.titre: Staple of my routine! Please never discontinue!!
avis.texte: I have been using the TO squalane for about 6 years and it is so so good to my sensitive, acne prone face skin! I put it on my hands as well, my fiance always comments on my soft hands. During winter I add vanicream face moisturizer and it's perfect.

avis.titre: Will keep your skin very Soft and Moisturized!!!
avis.texte: I looked it up and it's 100% Plant Derived from Sugar Cane just like BIOSSANCE brand that Dermatologists always recommend. I love Biossance so I decided to try it and it didn't disappoint!!! My skin is so Soft and Moisturized!!!! It is a product that won't breakout your skin either. I was skeptical before I tried Squalane but my skin is breakout free!!
My husband and I love using a few drops of this serum on our winter dried out hands, cuticles and finger tips. Nothing feels better than this and it is nongreasy and absorbs quickly.

avis.titre: The perfect moisturizer for those who don't like creams
avis.texte: This was the first product from The Ordinary that I tried and it's still in my regimen. I'm 52 with mostly oily skin. My skin was very oily when I was younger but that has gotten better as I've aged. However, a hill that I will die on is that if you treat oily skin like dry skin then your skin will balance out and this product is a great start. I use this on top of another serum that I use and my skin thanks me every time I put it on. I especially love this product because I don't care for creams on my skin and this hydrates without feeling heavy. I'll use it as long as they make it.
A little goes a long way. My skin has been inflamed from some acne. This is the perfect moisturizer and actually helped my redness. Also helped overall texture of skin too!

I use this on the ends of my hair and added to my body lotion. It is a great multi-tasking product and I love it for that. I have combination skin that can be acne prone. I probably could try it on my face but I haven't yet. If I get a new bottle maybe I'll try it.

avis.titre: I love it so much! I'm 40 years old woman!
avis.texte: I loved it! I'm a 40-year-old woman! The product has a light consistency, but it delivers the promised results.

I picked this up on a whim while browsing a few weeks ago. I'm absolutely obssessed and have been telling all my friends. I apply it twice a day before my moisturizer and have noticed such a difference. My face is smoother, softer, and hydrated. I have sensitive skin and get nervous adding new products to my routine. But I cannot recommend this enough!

I got this to moisturize my skin before makeup. I've tried multiple moisturizers but they just mess with the texture of my makeup even if I waited for it to absorb, or they'd make my skin get super greasy under my makeup after an hour regardless of how lightweight the moisturizer was. I wanted something super lightweight that felt natural and wouldn't affect my makeup. You only need 2-3 drops for the whole face, it feels like it doesn't spread far cause its so thin but trust me it does. If you use more it'll leave you oily. It takes about 5-10mins to absorb but once it does it feels completely natural like your skin but hydrated. I blot my face once it absorbs to get any excess off. If you have oily skin you'll probably want the hyaluronic serum since that one is water based, I haven't tried it though.

This is a good alternative to oils for skin and hair. I bought it for my damaged skin barrier, but it works better for actual skin problems. It actually healed stabbed over skin in a day. I happened to use it on a wound that had a scab and the scab came off the next day with no bleeding and only light pink skin. I tried it soon after on a rug burn with the same result. Amazing. It also works to calm flyaways in my hair. Use lightly and not on roots.
Absolutely love this serum, leaves my skin feeling so hydrated.

PLEASE ignore the bad reviews!!! I have been using this on my face for the last few years. I discovered this product after i completely destroyed my skin barrier and this stuff SAVED my skin!! I apply this as my second to last night time skincare routine, and follow it with CeraVe in the tub. You need to apply TO Squalane oil immediately after water based products , and BEFORE sunscreen or moisturizer. Applying this as the last step of a makeup routine is the dumbest thing i have read here. I guess if you want to take your makeup off, that would work. I have SUPER sensitive skin, as well as rosacea and TO squalane doesnt irritate me at all. It calms my skin down and reduces redness and dryness.

avis.titre: Please bring hemi-squalane back! This is too heavy
avis.texte: The hemi-saline was amazing. It wasn't too heavy and worked particularly well for my hair. I LOVE it. I tried the squareness and it's way too thick and heavy. Please please bring back hemi-squalane even if you need to increase the price.

Nothing has ever provided a better moisture fix for my skin than this product. For several months now, I have used this twice a day as the finishing layer for my skincare routine. My skin looks and behaves so much better using this instead of a cream or lotion moisturizer. It can feel a bit oily going on if I'm too generous, but it absorbs quickly into my skin, leaving it so nicely hydrated. My makeup sits better, and it has helped control a couple of dry patches that have never stood down to anything else.
I have the most sensitive acne prone skin and this product has been a lifesaver. It completely healed my skin after a very rough couple of months.

Made the mistake of switching from this Squalane to the Ordinary "B" oil. I don't even know why I did, but sadly I did and OMG the B oil smells so bad that I can't wait to go back to this product and never try something new again.
I honestly don't remember it being labeled or advertised for hair, but I tried it because I needed something like a hair oil that wouldnt make it greasy. This gives me exactly what I was looking for!

I use this in the evening and use it to lock in all my moisturizer. I am acne prone and find it helps with inflammation and reduces active breakouts. Doesn't leave your skin feeling oily and gross. Absorbs nicely into your skin 10/10 would recommend

avis.titre: Really like it for my acne skin
avis.texte: Ive only Been using it for a little over a week but man what a difference this has made to my skin! I have very problematic, flaky, acne prone, cloggged skin with seborrheic dermatitis. This is the first "oil" that hasn't broken me out, lays beautifully under makeup and is very soothing at night. 3 small drops is more than enough per application!!! Otherwise yes it will get oily. Haven't had any problems with pilling. I use it after cleansing and after my buffet serum (now called something else) and before my moisturizer. Excited for more positive results with continued usage ☺️
I lov(ed) your Hemi Squalane serum. I use it almost every day!! Why did you cancel Hemi Squalane???? :(( The normal one is way too concentrated and too oily! Please bring back my favorite product :(

This is one of three products I never want to be without. It has changed my skin. I thought my skin was aging but it was mainly dehydrated! ESPECIALLY in the winter. In case it's helpful, I use it after Cosrx's snail mucin and before either Sunday Riley's CEO cream or Dr. Brandt's Hydro Biotic. (And then sunscreen, of course.) No pilling!!! This is huge for me. I struggle with layering products and pilling.
Causes pilling when used with other serums/creams :< It's advertised as a serum but it's just an oil that doesn't combine with anything water-based, in my experience.

I love Indie Lee's squalane oil but it's expensive. I tried this one from The Ordinary because it was $28 cheaper…and after using it for two weeks, I've broken out and it made my skin sting after applying! I went back to old one and my skin is already clearer and does not sting.

My hair became dry, brittle and tangled mess when I was asked it. I have tried several moisturizing hair masks over the past month with no success. I used this oil 0n my scalp and hair and left it on overnight as I had done with the other products. It washed out easily, no tangles and my hair is restored back to its original state.

I'm sure this is a great product but I have allergy-prone skin as well as eczema. I normally get the Hyaluronic Acid but the Ulta near me was out so I tried this one. Didn't sting on contact but overnight, my skin became irritated.

avis.titre: Doesn't irritate my ridiculous sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: Doesn't irritate my ridiculous sensitive dry skin. I do have to reapply through out the day but my skin can tolerate it and it's more moisturizing than most moisturizers and it's affordable.
Wish I never bought this serum, it claims to be fast absorbing, but for me it's not, it leaves me looking like an oily and greasy mess. Won't be buying again.
Makes my skin look like glass without feeling greasy or looking oily. Gives me a healthy glow. A little gors a long way! I love this!!

I love this product so much that I'm leaving a review. If I ever forget it when out of town I get sad because my skin feels so dry without it. It's the perfect moisturizing oil/serum. I have acne prone skin too and was nervous but I doesn't break me out! 10/10 I like a lot of the ordinary products but this one is a game changer! I can't imagine not using it.

I bought this product a few weeks ago and i will never swap it out for anything else. personally, i have dry, dehydrated skin and i needed a product to help rebuild my hydration and skin textures. i used the ordinary suggestion and it works amazing! my favourite product by far!

avis.titre: The only soothing product that cured my burns from
avis.texte: I've always loved every The Ordinary product I've ever used- since the very beginning. I trust the transparency, simplicity, and realistic price points that created its own unique place in the industry. A few years ago I began using tretinoin, a prescription retinol, to address the facial skin problems like Milia, rough patches, Sun spots, early wrinkles, etc. Most know that when starting such a harsh product your face goes through a retinol-purge where your face is very red, angry, peeling, and it brings all the pimples and blemishes to the surface. It's part of the process but people aren't usually told how extremely painful it is because this new skin underneath the peeling is absolutely raw. Even sleeping was affected by pain. I needed something to soothe this fire-face feeling and my first go to was a popular drugstore moisturizer many dermatologists recommend but it burned so badly i had to run cool water on my face for half an hour. Then I tried 100% aloe Vera gel- what we put on painful sunburns. Aloe also burned so terribly. I looked to The Ordinary because it's so easy to find a specific product for whatever your specific need is. I found the 100% plant-derived Squalane and applied it immediately. It was the most soothing, calming, and hydrating experience I could have hoped for. The gentle purity and lightness evaporated right into my skin immediately. At that time, I really slathered it on and my skin drank it all up! Years later, I still use 100% Plant-Derived Sq

avis.titre: NOT nearly as magical as hemisqualine
avis.texte: Hemi squaline was my absolute favorite product for face and hair—lightweight and highly effective moisturizer. This is not it . Please reconsider hemi squaline!

avis.titre: Finally an oil that heals my skin
avis.texte: I moved back north and my skin was so dry it was falling off. I had sudden texture issues and anything I tried either had no effect or gave me breakouts. I finally tried The Ordinary and THIS oil has changed everything. I use it with the Vit F and HA moisturizer and im glowing even when im walking my dog for weeks in -30C weather. Thank you thank you thank you.
It's oil, I don't feel like it really penetrates into my skin. I will use it and finish it up, nothing special or great about this oil for me.

I love this stuff. It hydrates so well. It has changed the texture of my skin. I'm 65 with post menopause, my skin is dry, sensitive with breakouts. Go figure. Squalene has cleared up my complexion. Buy this it really works.

I have very dry skin and recently moved to a dryer climate than I grew up in. Have been using this for 3 years now and this is the only thing that keeps my skin feeling happy and moisturized. Definitely would not recommend unless you have pretty dry skin as it is on the greasy side. It takes a bit to settle into my skin but makes my skin feel great once it does! Love love love
If you have super dry face all year round i really recommend this serum its so life changing !!!

I love this to finish off my skincare routine at nighttime. I suffer from acne prone skin and find oils to clog my skin up. This actually helps minimize inflammation/redness if i have any breakout. I love the way my skin feels when i wake up and love the way this takes a while to absorb. My night time must have

I had flakey dry skin for years and didnt know what to do, I finally did some researxh and this changed my life and my skin so hydrated that all my flakey dry skin is gone! I I use it after cleansing then put moisturizer on top.

I had used this before on my face and experienced breakouts. I bought the product again, as I started using it on my hands and ends of hair. Tried it on my face again, very light application. Next morning my pores on cheeks and nose and chin were congested, and I had several white heads. I have dry skin, not oily skin. My skin also did not look any smoother or moisturized, just congested. Proceed with caution for use on face. 2 stars because I like it for use on hands/feet. I can't understand how this is advertised for the face.. I guess it works for some people. I'm 38 for reference and live in the high desert.

I bought this product to accompany other moisturizing agents for my skincare routine, and after using the entirety of the product, I've decided not to repurchase it as I feel it wasn't spectacular enough of a product to warrant adding to my regular routine. Nothing is wrong with the product, I just found better results in other products and didn't notice much of, if any, difference in my skin after stopping use.

I'm glad that this is working for some users, but this product is NOTHING like the HEMI-squalane that was recently discontinued and which was my hands-down #1 GOAT Ordinary product. I hate that it's gone. I can't use this one at all: it's thicker and greasier than the hemi, and is not only too heavy for use in hair but it also makes my skin break out like crazy (which the hemi never did). Please, please, please consider manufacturing BOTH products - you are reaching two totally different user bases with each one.

Warning this is long and detailed! A little background before I get into the nitty gritty. Skip to the fifth paragraph, Monday, if it's not your thing: A. I love TO products and NEVER had an issue with any skincare product I've tried. B. Squalane is a hydrogenated oil and should NOT oxidize. This is often confused with squalene, which naturally occurs in our body and is a moisturizer. It comes from three sources sharks, rice bran, or olives. Being 100% plant derived I'm assuming it's from rice or olives. Neither of which I'm allergic to; I have used olive oil on my skin and hair with no issues. C. I used this for my face and felt that it never absorbed into my skin—just sat on top and wasn't a fan so I started using it for my hair. Reading the instructions, I thought it was safe for any part of the hair including my scalp. I felt that it was great—hydrating and did a good job on the dry spots near my temples and never had an issue with the small usage. I did this a few times before I did it on a large part of my scalp and counted it as a spot test. I had no reactions so I used it a little more liberally recently since it's the winter and my scalp was a bit drier post wash. Sunday 12/10—My hair was washed and dried via blow dryer. I do not use anything, but pure castor oil as a heat protectant to blow dry my hair. Shampoo and conditioner was from a reputable natural hair brand. I've used these products for months, and I've never had any issues prior to this. Monday 12/11—I str

This is probably the worst thing I have ever put on my face. The product itself isn't bad, but my skin absolutely hates it. Pimples all over my face (which never happens to me) after using it just once or twice. I did trial it a few times as I wasn't sure if this was the culprit, but it definitely was. Never again. It's just not for me. I will be sticking to my favourite hydrator, The Ordinary's Amino Acids + B5 serum.

I moved to Milan from Asia (where using a moisturiser for my skin was enough). I could only go through winters of Milan by using this. My face looked better, too. If I go out, I first use this and do my makeup. My skin looks like it glows, and my skin never glows otherwise. So, this was a gem changer for me. For people who are suffering from breakout, just a suggestion, check what else you are using with it. I break out if I use a scented moisturiser, but I don't have breakouts if I use something non-scented from the pharmacy.

I have been using this for years, used PTR unoil prior to The Ordinary and that was discontinued. It too was sugar cane derived squalene but was a tad bit thicker in consistency. I found this as an alternative and have used since. I mainly use it around my eyes as a serum underneath my eye creams. I suffer from allergies and medical dry eye so this does help me retain moisture in the skin around my eyes. I use a couple drops patted into the skin both day and night, followed by Tatcha Ageless eye cream. Works like a charm.
I like the way this feels and it does a good job of moisturizing, but unfortunately, I had to stop using because it makes my skin break out.

Love this product specially for winter. My skin gets very dry in the cooler months and this has been my lifesaver. I typically use it at night and leaves my skin super moisturized for the next day. Highly recommended. Although its an oil it has not giving me any breakouts.

I never really write reviews on products but this stuff really is that amazing. I either apply two drops directly on my face each morning or I'll mix it into my foundation for a smoother application. It always brings my face back to life in the morning and leaves my skin feeling smooth and fresh!! Also, a bottle lasts forever!!

I have oily skin, thought this would be light enough to use in the winter, but not for me. Started using as hair serum, now I can't live without! I have dry 3b curls so it might not work for fine hair. I use it after leave-in on wash and go days and a bit on my ends to finish of blow dry. Works better than many other expensive serums and natural oils for me.

I use this everyday after cleanser and toner as my moisturizer/oil before makeup or spf. I might layer with a heavier cream if my skin is extra dry in the winter but usually this is all I need! It's funny because it's recommended as a treatment but it feels like a really clean light oil that leaves my skin perfectly hydrated without any extra lotion. I seriously have bought so many, that now I buy 4 at a time. A bigger size would be amazing please!
I love this product! I use it twice a day as a Gua Sha lubricant on my face and neck. It is moisturizing but not greasy.

avis.titre: Most amazing oil I've ever used
avis.texte: This has been my holy grail for almost 10 years now. It has saved my dry skin especially during those cold Canadian winter months.

i have incredibly dry and sensitive skin and with winter creeping up i decided to get something to give me extra hydration. this oil is amazing!! i use it as a last step in my skincare routine both morning and night. sometimes if i feel a bit too oily after i use a gua sha to massage my face. my skin is so plump and hydrated i couldnt be happier!
I use this product for my hair 2-3 times a week and it helps with dry ends.

AMAZING HYDRATION!!! Love that it is ONLY 1 ingredient! And that is all it needs. Amazing hydration with no oily feeling. I have been using for over 5 years, am now 50. Use it morning and night. My favorite way to use is mixing with a scoop of the 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder at night and apply to my face, mostly cheeks and upper chest area, to help reduce uneven skin tone. My 25 old daughter has been using for years and my 13 year old daughter just started using! It is now a FAMILY THING…I just wish The Ordinary was around when I was their age:)
This product is great for the price but I prefer Indie Lee because it's thicker.

Love this serum! I add two drops into my moisturizer and it really helps enhance the hydration. My skin is dry, but after using this it definitely feels more plump than regular moisturizer alone. I havent tried this in my hair, but it is very lightweight and non-greasy. It has also helped moisturize my cuticles and lips. It is also way more cost effective for me to buy this bottle and add to my existing skincare, than to purchase another product that has squalane in its ingredient list.

avis.titre: This is the Frank's Red Hot of cosmetics
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing! I have dry combination skin and I use it in the mornings underneath tinted moisturizer and I look so much younger! (I'm 36). I use it on lips and the ends of my hair too. I love it!

Please bring back the Hemi-Squalane!! It was perfect for my very fine hair, but last time I came to buy it it was gone. I decided to try this Squalane but it just leaves my hair lank and greasy looking, even with just a few drops. The only use I've found for it is for extra hydration on my skin overnight after using the AHA/BHA Peeling Solution. If you have thicker/coarser hair, this may be for you, but stay away if you have fine, straight hair!
I've been using this product for 2-3 years now and I'm still in love with it. I only use 3 Drops! Keeps face from dryness, no face irritation, no flakes left on face.

avis.titre: Are you there, Deciem? It's me, ….
avis.texte: This feels great on my skin, but I would love some direction ab how/when to apply to hair? Wet/dry? Leave on/rinse out?

avis.titre: I buy these by the handful
avis.texte: I literally buy these 4 at a time. They're SO good. Whenever they run out, my skin somehow gets super dry and also breaks out. I'm a customer for life. You have to be ok with the feeling of some oil on your skin, but it's soo silky smooth and feels so good. Recommend 200%.

I have dry/combo skin and sweat easily. I first got this as an oil to use for dermaplaning for the first time at home (oil-planing). It felt really good on my skin as I was doing it, I started to use it as a "lightweight moisturizer" at night without the NMF+HA. My skin was feeling so smooth in the morning waking up. Then I started using it in tandem with my routine. HA serum on damp skin, then this oil then seal it in with the lotion. I use a little of each layer so it's not super heavy. I wake up HYDRATED!! Not a sticky feeling, not super heavy or oily. I'm so happy I got this!
I love this squalene! I overused exfoliants and acne products on my face. This saved my skin barrier bringing all the hydration back. My skin is dewy and more plump.
I love squalane for dry face and this product doesn't disappoint me. The oiliness is not overwhelming which is good.

I love The Ordinary & bought this squalene on a whim since I had some reward points to use. A little goes a long way & too much can feel/look oily, but a few drops after my normal skin care routine has left me with glass-like, airbrushed skin! I put some cream blush, mascara, and eyebrows on and *chef's kiss*. I've gotten so many compliments!

This oil has been the one consistent part of my skincare routine over the past few years. The times I've tried switching to something "fancier" I always end up coming back to it. Hydrates well, doesn't irritate blemishes, zero scent, works great under a gua sha. I also love that squalane is a fully saturated fat and not a PUFA, making it less likely to oxidize and cause exposure to free radicals.
Hydrating and plumping. Skin looks so healthy and no pimples for months.
If you burn easily in the sun, forget the aloe ladies, TRY THIS! This absolutely SAVED my skin when i got a second degree sunburn. Your skin will drink this up and my hair loved it too!

I have been using this oil since the beginning.I remember placing a huge order on the Canada website and I must have gotten 1 of everything lol. This is 1 of the 5 products that I can't live without! Its so light weight I believe all skin types could benefit from this product.

avis.titre: If I could drink this stuff, I would
avis.texte: Seriously... A miracle elixir for my complexion!! I'm in my late 20s with dry-leaning skin and mild hormonal acne, and my current AM/PM routine of hyaluronic acid + moisturizing factors+HA + plant-derived squalane (+spf during the day) has been the best combo so far to keep my skin dewy, clear, and even. Like, I even notice a big difference when I skip a single morning or evening. I've tried and enjoyed other oils (rosehip, "B" oil), but this one is really something special. Plus, no scent and minimal oiliness for those who are bothered by that. I'm addicted!

I am new to proper skincare, and I have been doing a lot of research on products and proper layering, and all of that good stuff! It's overwhelming and I can't believe I waited so long to start a daily regimen. Starting later in life, I decided to try this line because their website is great for learning. They walk you through what your skin type may need and how to layer for the results you are looking for. They offer so many products and I like that I can use one brand for all of my personal needs. And the price is right! This particular product from The Ordinary is a must! I've been using it for two months now and feel comfortable giving a positive review. And the bonus here, is after you apply to your face, you can swipe it through your hair as well!

avis.titre: Been using for years, it's always been my go-to
avis.texte: Can't believe I never wrote a review on this oil. It's a god send for me. I have acne prone skin, super sensitive, and I started using this at a time in my life when my skin was always inflamed and oily and generally unhealthy. I needed something to stabilize it and hydrate it while I started acne treatments life Differin and Benzoyl Peroxide and this always did the trick. Granted this past winter my skin needed a bit more hydration so I started using a moisturizer for the first time but 99% of the time, this is all I need on its own but 100% of the time, this goes in my routine -- morning and night as a last step before sunscreen. I also use it in my hair and my barber always compliments the sleek and healthiness of my hair. I almost always have about 2 dozen bottles in storage from sales because I never want to run out. I hope this never gets discontinued. I'll be the first to buy all the stock.

So glad I added this to my routine. Paired with hyaluronic serum, this oil is bomb. It's helped with my skin dryness from my rosacea, and also any kind of skin texture I'm dealing with. No gross oily feel, no new blemishes. Chef kiss for sure :)

avis.titre: Makes my face feel so soft
avis.texte: Love how soft and smooth this makes my face feel. I will definitely purchase again.

My skin is all messed up so I don't try new things much anymore. I actually bought this for my scalp but saw a reccomendation for squalane when looking at skin barrier repair information and though might as well. And it's amazing. It barely hurt when putting it on (high praise believe me) And I was able to tolerate it on my skin for several hours before I washed my face. It's now the next day and I've washed my face a second time and I can still feel its (amazing!) effects. I'm honestly stunned at the (somewhat lasting) change this has made to my skin after one application. Won't leave pics cause they'd just scare people away but seriously wow. I'm hooked.

avis.titre: This a a new HG product for me.
avis.texte: This squalane is great! The price is right and it's just what I was looking for. It has so many uses. Sometimes I mix it with my body lotion, put it over moisturizer to seal it in, tame fly away hairs, and I recently started using it on my stretch earlobes because the product I used to use was not super sanitary and I think it was irritating my seborrheic dermatitis. This is SD and FA friendly so I'll probably be switching to using this for my lobes all the time.

I bought this to use on my short grey hair but decided to try it out on my face after reading all of the positive reviews. I love it! I have very reactive sensitive skin which is now dry post-menopause having been oily all my life. I feel like I'm having to relearn skincare! I'm now using this in the morning and it works great under make-up. As it's not an oil, it's not at all greasy and disappears into my skin leaving it moisturised and comfortable. Highly recommended.
This oil is so light and feels amazing on the skin. It sinks in beautifully and quickly leaving no residue behind.
mix a couple drops into your moisturizer & slap that baby on your face.. chef's kiss

avis.titre: In LOVE with this serum, so smoothing and hydrating!
avis.texte: I have tried manyyyy hydrating serums, and this one is by far my fave even when compared with very high end ones. Added this to my routine last winter as I tend to get dry, flaky skin during winter and I noticed a difference right away. My skin stayed hydrated and smooth for Longer and overall just had more of a glow once I incorporated this. I will say, it does tend to feel a bit oily and take slightly Longer to "sink in" than other formulas. It does sink in, but there's a short period of feeling like it's sitting on top of your skin before doing so. If that bothers you you may not like it. It's also very liquidy- so you have to move kinda fast putting it on. For me, none of those are na issue given the fantastic results though!

If you have dry skin, you need this. I started using this over my serums and under my moisturizer and my skin has never felt more moisturized. It does seem a little greasy, but I usually only use it at night so it doesn't bother me.

I bought this initially for dry skin but it's way more intense than I need. On a whim I rubbed a few drops of this in my curly, frizzy, dry, dull hair and was SHOOK. Look. I don't have shiny hair, I never have. This restored my curls, made my hair shine, it's so soft, and frizz free. I'm stunned.

avis.titre: LOVE IT, I buy it every time!
avis.texte: I have dry skin especially along the T area of my face. It works great by hydrating my skin and lasts me a pretty long time! Just takes 3 drops and my skin feels super hydrated for the day. I incorporate this into my daily skincare and love it. IT IS A MUST
i add a few drops to my cerave am moisturizer with spf, and they work great together. my skin is no longer dull or dry, it feels soft, supple, and it looks glowy
Not recommend to apply on your skin because it would make your skin very dry. Like dehydration.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over again
avis.texte: I love this product, my daughter recommended it. I've got many compliments on how my face looks and what are you using. Definitely will continue using it.
I really wanted to love this but I put it on and I feel like I soaked my face in vegetable oil. It may work very well but I'm not sure if I can get past how greasy it feels

avis.titre: My skin is hydrated than ever!
avis.texte: This is my 4th bottle and it's by far giving me the best hydration, not only to my face but also to my hair. It feels so light on my skin too.

This was an impulsive purchase but I definitely don't regret it! My skin is generally very dry and this winter was especially harsh. My face looked flaky and dull but this product improved it noticeably in about a week! Now my skin looks and feels much smoother and no more flakiness! Will definitely repurchase.

avis.titre: SAVED MY SKIN IN THE ARCTIC
avis.texte: If you're getting a moisturiser and a cleanser and they also recommend this and you're wondering whether it's worth it you probably won't use it, I can tell you it's worth it, get it. I got this with the natural moisturising factors +HA and squalene cleanser after doing their little quiz thing. I previously had random red eczema-like flare ups all over my body and a persistent patch on my face which didn't go away with or without moisturiser. I also wear a lot of dark eye makeup most days. After a couple of weeks using only these products on my face the red patch went away and didn't come back even if I had flare ups elsewhere on my body. I still didn't really use the oil though. Then I went to work in the Arctic circle in northern Canada, talking -50°c dry snow and wind chafing on the snow mobiles. The first week my skin had a huge reaction (red itchy dry) so I started putting the oil on after moisturising twice a day to protect it. The reaction went away within a week and not only did I not get any more dryness or flare ups the whole time I was there, my skin is probably in the best condition rit has been in years, without makeup, glowing is not an understatement. So if they recommend this for you, get it and use it! Everyone's skin is different obv but definitely try it out.

This stuff SAVED my skin. I've never had dry skin before, but this winter was brutal. Within one application I could see a difference in my skin. It felt and looked so much better. My mom even tried it and loves it too. I put it on under my face lotion everyday.

avis.titre: Only thing that hydrates my extremely dry forehead
avis.texte: I wish this was in stock more often because my skin won't survive without it!!! My skin is extreeeemely dry - please help! Bring it back!

avis.titre: I have used Squalane for over 30 years.
avis.texte: My skin loves Squalane! I turn 74 tomorrow and am asked often what I do for skincare. I am told often how lovely my skin is. I attribute a lot of it to years of using Squlane daily.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. It adds great moisture to my skin. It has a very light feeling. It is great to use especially in the winter time.
